messages.author: 28dfb648fee225ef
messages.subject: Updating affxparser on Linux server
parts:
Hi,

I was trying to update aroma.affymetrix to v9.0.5 on my linux server
with R 2.7.0 lately. After I ran the two lines of code for update, I
was told to update package R.methodsS3 to >=1.0.3, then I did:

source("http://www.braju.com/R/hbLite.R")
hbLite(c("R.methodsS3"))

Using repository: http://www.braju.com/R/repos
Identified packages to be processed: utils, R.methodsS3
Installing external packages...
Packages: utils
Updating packages: utils
01/01. utils: not available.
Installing external packages...done
Installing braju.com packages...
Packages: R.methodsS3
Updating packages: R.methodsS3
01/01. R.methodsS3: v1.0.3, i.e. up to date.
Installing braju.com packages...done

So it looks fine and then I tried to update aroma.affymetrix again, I
was told to update package affxparser to >=1.13.8, then I ran the
similar code again but got:

hbLite(c("affxparser"))

Using repository: http://www.braju.com/R/repos
Identified packages to be processed: affxparser
Installing external packages...
Packages: affxparser
Updating packages: affxparser
01/01. affxparser: not available.
Installing external packages...done

Looks like I could not update affxparser in this way, can anyone help
me with this problem?

Thanks a lot,

Rachel Jia

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Updating affxparser on Linux server
parts:
Hi,

affxparser is on BioC, so you'll need to do:

biocLite("affxparser");

Though, I'm surprised that hbInstall("aroma.affymetrix") didn't
install it (and R.methodsS3) for you.

/Henrik

messages.author: a5f6afcbe5b17914
messages.subject: Re: Updating affxparser on Linux server
parts:
Hi,

you the way the BioC installation scripts are setup, is that it will
require everyone to use the most recent version of R and since R
v2.8.0 was release last week, R v2.7.x is outdated in their
perspective. Hence you will not get access to the BioC v2.3
repository (just release) but only the previous version BioC v2.2
(last half year). If you happen to run the new developers/alpha/beta
version of R, R v2.9.0dev, you will get access to BioC v2.4 repository
where all developers/alpha/beta version of the BioC packages sits.
This is described (somewhere) on the BioC webpage and make sure you
understand it if you're going to use a lot BioC packages.

So, with R v2.7.0 you only get access to BioC v2.2 but the required
version affxparser is in BioC v2.3. You should update R to R v2.8.0
- that'll help you. However, in the meanwhile, I've provided a "hack"
that allows you to install packages from BioC v2.3 although you run R
v2.7.x:

source("http://www.bioconductor.org/biocLite.R")
biocLite("affxparser", rver="2.8.0")

This will trick the BioC installation scripts to think you're running
R v2.8.0.

Then you should get affxparser v1.14.0 (I think).

/Henrik
